payload.summary: Accept the two amendments with verified defects (alk_budget bookkeeping gap and unconditionally allocating metric()); reject the two whose factual premises are contradicted by the current repository state.

votes.rationale: Verified: alk_budget is decremented after AOB (line 296) but NOT after comammox (~line 350), while do_budget IS decremented after both steps. The comammox_alk_cost is computed but never subtracted from alk_budget. This is an asymmetry with the DO budget pattern and a latent accounting bug — if any future step reads the remaining alkalinity budget it will see a stale, over-stated value. The proposed one-line fix is low-risk, consistent with the existing pattern, and closes the invariant gap.

Verified: StageTrace::metric() unconditionally calls label.into() (heap String allocation) and pushes a BudgetMetric every time, even when ctx.budget is None and the metrics will never be consumed. In contrast, note() already guards on self.enabled. For nitrogen_cycle alone this is ~5 wasted allocations per tick on the cold path. Adding a guard (either checking a budget_active flag or ctx.budget.is_some()) is behavior-preserving and eliminates unnecessary heap churn when budget tracking is disabled.

The premise is factually incorrect. crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs exists on disk AND is tracked by git (confirmed via git ls-files). The file is already part of the reviewed change set.

The premise is factually incorrect. NitrogenCycleOutput already exposes both alkalinity_consumed_meq (line 28) and alkalinity_produced_meq (line 34), and the engine emits both as metrics (lines 248-255) and as trace notes (lines 265-271). The claimed gap — that only consumed alkalinity is surfaced — does not exist in the current code. Consumed-vs-returned attribution is already possible with the existing API surface.
